title: lore link writes the concept's tasks: frontmatter before the Quest back-ref write, so a missing actor exits 6 with the link half-applied
description: Measured 2026-09-25 with dist/lore 0.9.2 built from dev and quest 0.10.0, in a fresh git repo after lore init + quest init + two quest task create. 'lore link stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders task-1 task-2' with LORE_QUEST_ACTOR unset exits 6 'Quest write requires an explicit actor declaration', yet docs/stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders.md afterwards carries tasks: [task-1, task-2] and a later lore sync renders both in the managed task block. The doc:<id> back-ref labels were not written. So a refused command leaves one side of a two-sided coupling. Either the actor check should run before any write, or the frontmatter write should be rolled back. Found while fixing the README quickstart (LCLI-571).

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore link with no Quest actor declared exits 6 and leaves the concept file byte-identical
A test covers the refused case and asserts the file is unchanged
